name: Tandoori Oven (Logan, UT) Warm Clay-Oven Baked Plain Naan Bread
whyItWorks: Plain tandoor naan is pillowy, soft, and easy to tear. Brushed lightly with ghee (clarified butter, virtually free of lactose and casein). Soothing carb companion in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Plain Naan (not garlic naan) baked fresh in the clay tandoor oven.
watchOuts: Choose plain naan over garlic naan to avoid allium fructans
